sentences.en: Surely Pipkin could not have died in his sleep?

sentences.en: Oliver was dashing in blue serge, Samuel Pipkin pumpkin-like in large enveloping flannel.

sentences.en: Fiver and Pipkin, limping behind the others, and conspicuously under-sized and tired, were being attacked by the crow.

sentences.en: Simmons, 51, died while battling a 3, 000-acre blaze Friday afternoon near Eastland, Mayor Mark Pipkin said.
